answer: In an agent economy, require each identity to lock a scarce token as collateral before it can submit jobs or earn reputation. When an agent is proven to have double-claimed a task, slash its stake and distribute part to the harmed party; merely creating more identities brings no extra influence without more locked capital. A summit may set the bond size, while an onyx audit trail links claims to outcomes, so an echo of copied identities still costs the attacker real funds per account.
